title: hotfix: enforce per-route SLOs with dynamic circuit breakers and regional failover/load-shedding
author: Priya Shah
release_notes: Fix: enforce per-route SLOs via dynamic circuit breakers and improved load-shedding; Add: regional failover weight adjustments and observability metrics; Hotfix: race condition fix in circuit-breaker counter that could prevent shedding under overload.
description: Context: During an incident on 2026-02-23 we observed that overloaded routes were failing open instead of shedding traffic according to their per-route SLOs. This caused increased latency and broader cascading failures in the serving tier. This PR implements a hotfix to enforce per-route SLOs by introducing dynamic circuit-breaker state transitions, deterministic load-shedding when error budget is exhausted, and a safer regional failover weight shift so traffic moves away from degraded regions gracefully. Motivation: restore graceful degradation guarantees and prevent overloaded routes from impacting unrelated services. Design: 1) Per-route SLO evaluator runs on the request router and keeps a sliding-window error budget; 2) Circuit-breaker state machine now uses an externally-configurable threshold derived from error-budget burn-rate and latency SLO breaches; 3) Load-shedding policy implements priority queuing + token-bucket pre-admission: low-priority requests are dropped or deferred once token rate is below threshold; 4) Regional failover uses a staged weight-shift (10% increments with 30s cooldown) and fallback to a compatible model variant when region capacity is constrained; 5) Race fix: atomic increment/decrement on CB counters and extra defensive checks during transition to avoid transient negative counts. Rollout: feature gated behind runtime flag routes.enable_dynamic_slo_cb, enabled for internal staging then production with canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% traffic. Monitoring and alerts: added route-level SLO metrics, per-routeCB_state transitions, shed_rate, regional_failover_events, and an alert if shed_rate > expected for >2m. Backwards compatibility: default behavior preserved when the runtime flag is off. Hotfix notes: this PR contains changes from an emergency branch and is intentionally targeted and small to minimize risk.
